item.title: California’s AI Laws: What Changes in January 2026
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: January 13, 2026
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence Regulation", "Technology Law", "AI Safety and Ethics", "Risk Management", "California Legislation"]
Summary:
  • California's new AI laws take effect January 1, 2026.
  • They require active risk management and real-time safety monitoring.
  • Companies must document and report AI system behaviors continuously.
  • The laws focus on preventing real-world harms from AI deployment.
  • SB 53 targets large-scale AI developers with strict compliance rules.
  • This marks a shift from voluntary ethics to enforceable legal obligations.
